name: consolidate-memory
description: Cross-project, verification-first memory for Claude Code — the layer beyond the built-in Auto Dream. Shares memory across enrolled projects in the same trust domain (a governed store, replicated into those projects) and verifies facts against the live code (grep/file/git), dropping what it can't confirm — fact-checked, domain-scoped memory, plus tiered context-budget accounting. Unenrolled projects are local-only until enrolled. Where Auto Dream auto-consolidates each project, this is the explicit, rigorous complement; invoke by asking to consolidate / checkpoint / "dream" your memory.
